cn.t: Critics praise this timely revival's spectacular cast and contemporary resonance, though some find Bradshaw's revisions uneven. Rubin-Vega and the ensemble earn raves, making Rice's century-old expressionist satire feel urgently relevant to AI-age anxieties.
